confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Siem Reap prices, not checked against live menus, listings or booking sites. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weak. Hotel and hostel rates vary widely by area and season, and the July low-season adjustment is approximate. FX not verified: no RBA observation for the latest date could be confirmed, so the fx date and rate are null rather than estimated.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors reflect Cambodian and mainland Southeast Asian tourist-town price levels, adjusted for Siem Reap's Angkor-driven hotel demand and its common USD-denominated tourist pricing. Hoi An and Luang Prabang were loose regional reference points.

anchor_basis.beer: Angkor draft beer (about 330 ml) at a casual restaurant, about 6,000 riel
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a mid-range cafe, about 10,000 riel
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: amok or lok lak at a local eatery, about 14,000 riel
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three courses for two at a mid-range restaurant, no drinks, about 160,000 riel for both
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail at a Pub Street bar, about 20,000 riel
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass at a restaurant, about 24,000 riel
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a 6-8 bed dorm at a central hostel, about 26,000 riel
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a central hostel, about 80,000 riel
